scope: Native-EMC BCL2 tissue-protein source/method/condition/diagnostic-control context for independently owned pharmacology source gate, not a positivity or IHC-outcome paper.
pharmacology_context: Venetoclax source-name coverage exists in native USZ20/NCC1 screens; actual response values are not opened here. Missing class controls and incompatible assays cannot be repaired by BCL2 protein staining.
questions: What native case/material, antibody, compartment, scoring/threshold, fixation and positive/negative diagnostic controls does the source actually establish for BCL2?
Does any same-material/time/model protein crosswalk support measurement interpretation of a drug-class comparison, beyond prior diagnostic positivity?
What source-specific negative/inconclusive or alias/family ambiguity prevents BCL2 staining from implying dependence?

prospective_branches.branch: verified pathology reuse and actual panel check
prospective_branches.inputs: Phase7 older mimic BioC, existing Oliveira/Mayo and verified clinical/pathology records. Do not assume BCL2 was assayed merely because IHC mentioned. No new biological matrices.

prospective_branches.branch: at most one additional primary native BCL2 assay-method source
prospective_branches.selection: Exact disease+BCL2 or exact existing Okamoto/Hisaoka18 citation source metadata; choose source-authenticated protein methods/all native material/control group over generic stain statement, before any drug values. Ordinary public source only, no repeated failed route.

value_standard: Measured BCL2 may establish presence at the assay/time/compartment, not antiapoptotic occupancy, functional priming or dependency. A public same-model/time functional perturbation or selective class comparison would be needed for dependence; no rescue of absent controls. BCL2, BCL2L1/BCL-XL and MCL1 are separate proteins and inhibitors are not interchangeable.
defeat: Generic already-published positivity, absent specific target/assay/control identity, no same-material drug link, family mismatch, or missing contrary/class controls means context-only/no standalone claim.
exposure: Prior R1–R9 published IHC/drug facts may already be known. Current task reads methods/prior-art/context; no invented fully blinded claim. Fresh outcome matrices, raw drug endpoints and ordinal-stain/RNA/IC50 pooling are OFF.
all_public_coverage: All identifiable native material/conditions in an advancing source; other known relevant source gaps retained pending. This finite context review is not all-literature body coverage or campaign exhaustion.
